item.title: Sai Centre of Ba brings smiles to 78 residents with food donation at Daulomani Safe Home
item.description: A simple act of love and kindness brought smiles to the residents of Daulomani Safe Home in Lautoka, as members of the Sri Sathya Sai Global Council Fiji from the Sai Centre of Ba donated food supplies to support their daily needs. The home currently cares for 78 residents.
item.content:encoded:
A simple act of love and kindness brought smiles to the residents of Daulomani Safe Home in Lautoka, as members of the Sri Sathya Sai Global Council Fiji from the Sai Centre of Ba donated food supplies to support their daily needs.

The home currently cares for 78 residents.

The visit was part of the Sai Centre of Ba's community service activities marking the 101st birthday of Sai Baba.

The initiative was led by President of the Sai Centre of Ba, Sister Rinu Devi, who recognised the needs of the home and brought members together to make the donation possible.

When the members saw the happiness on the residents' faces, it reminded them that even a small act of kindness can bring comfort and brighten someone's day.

The Sai Centre of Ba has thanked everyone who contributed towards the initiative and says it remains committed to reaching out to people in need.
